errors.text: The proposed SPD-plus-annealing route does not reconstruct the target hexahedron-anvil HPHT treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
The phase description changes the required FCC/B2 alloy into a BCC-matrix/B2 system, making the proposed structural mediator inconsistent with the specified material.

The HIP comparison varies prior severe plastic deformation rather than cleanly isolating extreme pressure, and its stated pressure is ambiguous because the annealing step has no defined applied pressure.
The proposed 800–900 °C window, unspecified strain, and unspecified hold time do not match or substantiate the target processing window.
Evidence for a reticulated Laves phase in a refractory HfMoTaTiZrCr alloy is not sufficient evidence that B2 in Al0.7CoCrFeNi will undergo the claimed transformation.
